status: fixed before V6 fitting; post-hoc development exploration after V1-V5 results were viewed
question: Can an auxiliary task on the original training windows make the unchanged LSTM32-to-3D representation useful for SRT next-day raw-return forecasting?

fixed_primary_task.input: saved original 20x6 SRT/STI/SORA tensor, bitwise unchanged
fixed_primary_task.target: saved original next-SRT-trading-day raw close log return
fixed_primary_task.architecture: one LSTM with 32 hidden units, tanh 3D projection, two Gaussian rules and two affine experts for the Fuzzy2 arms

auxiliary_task.input: training-scaled 20x6 windows; set the three SRT-derived channels to training mean (scaled zero) for the final five historical days; leave STI and as-published SORA channels visible
auxiliary_task.target: the scaled five historical SRT daily returns at the masked positions, from each training window only
auxiliary_task.head: temporary affine map from the same tanh 3D representation to five masked returns; discard before primary training and inference
auxiliary_task.training: 20 fixed epochs, AdamW learning rate 0.001 and weight decay 0.0001, batch size 64, MSE, gradient clip 1; no validation-based auxiliary selection
auxiliary_task.scope: inner pretraining uses only inner fit windows; outer refit pretraining uses only the full outer train windows; no unlabeled outer validation or final windows

primary_training: unchanged V1 AdamW settings, original target standardization, last 15% inner stop for best epoch and same-seed outer restart/refit; no parameter scan
attribution: random-vs-pretrained frozen Fuzzy2 diagnoses representation; pretrained-vs-original Fuzzy2 tests the whole model training change; pretrained LSTM3 tests whether the same auxiliary task also benefits a plain head; Gaussian-specific advantage is not claimed without a same-pretraining Gate2 control
resource_budget: 18 auxiliary fits (inner and outer per fold/seed), 36 downstream model runs (four arms x three folds x three seeds); if the full pretrained Fuzzy2 passes the candidate gate, a separate matched pretrained Gate2 experiment may be planned
candidate_gate: mean seed-pooled raw-return RMSE at least 1% below both original Fuzzy2 and Z0, at least two of three fold-mean RMSEs below Z0, at least six of nine paired fold-seed RMSEs below original Fuzzy2, and pooled MAE no more than 1% above Z0
substantial_goal: at least 3% mean seed-pooled raw-return RMSE reduction versus the strongest fixed same-information reference, presently Z0; a development resource goal, not a course rule or independent significance test
stopping: report all four arms, failed runs, early-stop epochs and auxiliary losses; if the candidate gate fails, do not relabel a linear-head gain or clearer rule weights as Fuzzy2 success and do not start staged-expert training from this candidate
outputs: development predictions, per-fold and pooled metrics, training traces, source/data/contract hashes and decision; no final-period predictions
